decisions.reason: As a close extension of the established range in a growing market, this product would likely be retained because its fit with existing engineering, sales and service capabilities lowers uncertainty and there is no clear sign of performance below aspiration.

Management would likely keep this articulated dumper because it builds directly on the firm's core construction equipment business and, absent evidence of a clear shortfall, available organisational slack supports continued market learning.

Although more distant from the established offer, the firm's innovation orientation, in-house R&D and specialist underground-vehicle capabilities make it plausible to continue this rescue vehicle at least another period while results remain uncertain rather than clearly below aspiration.

This compact telescopic loader is close to the firm's existing offer and should be kept because it can use existing technical and commercial resources efficiently, with no reported evidence yet justifying a problem-driven withdrawal.
